groups.text: It is currently 17 degrees and cloudy in Berlin-Tempelhof.
With the morning weather set, here is the news.

Andon Labs is placing autonomous AI agents in charge of real businesses to test their capabilities. At the Andon Café in Stockholm, an agent named Mona manages the budget, sets the menu, and orders supplies. Other experiments have led to more erratic results, including a vending machine that stocked live fish and underwear, and an AI radio DJ that repeated a single catchphrase 229 times a day. One AI manager in San Francisco even fired a human employee. While these agents take on operational roles, they also introduce new security vulnerabilities. Dark Reading reports that agentic AI presents a new insider threat model for organizations. This risk coincides with a broader struggle among enterprises to manage security risks as cloud adoption grows. To address these gaps, industry experts are holding virtual events focused on securing multi-cloud environments and identifying cyber risks to cloud assets in the age of AI.

Santiago Muzio has resigned as the director of the Maison de l'Argentine in Paris. Located on the campus of the Cité internationale universitaire, the center became a flashpoint for controversy after the government of libertarian President Javier Milei appointed Muzio in 2024. He faced accusations of organizing far-right meetings and allegedly removing a plaque honoring victims of the Argentine dictatorship. There were also claims that he carried out illegal expulsions of residents. The Assembly of Argentine Citizens in France celebrated the departure, describing it as a victory against authoritarianism and negationism. A source from Argentina's Ministry of Human Capital confirmed the resignation to the AFP. Alfredo Mario Soto, the vice-rector of the University of Rosario, will take over the leadership role. This shift follows months of public tension surrounding the administration of the cultural house in the south of Paris.

Jack Shepherd has been jailed for twenty months, plus four years on extended licence, after admitting to violently assaulting his girlfriend. At Isleworth Crown Court, the thirty-eight-year-old pleaded guilty to damaging property and two counts of assault occasioning actual bodily harm, including an incident where he hit the woman with hot barbecue tongs. Shepherd was originally imprisoned in 2018 for manslaughter following a fatal speedboat crash on a first date, and later served time for attacking a barman. In separate corporate news, Nomadar Corp filed an 8-K report with the SEC on September 14th, disclosing a material definitive agreement and unregistered sales of equity securities. Meanwhile, in the tech sector, organizations are grappling with the speed of AI integration; a virtual event scheduled for October 8th will address how enterprises can build secure AI strategies to balance operational power with necessary security guardrails.

In Nepal, the aftermath of August 26 floods has left more than 1,386 people dead and over 5,130 missing as of September 12. The disaster along the Bhote Koshi river has prompted the government to request rapid support from the Fund for Responding to Loss and Damage, a United Nations financial mechanism established in 2022. Ministers Swarnim Wagle and Gita Chaudhary argue that Nepal bears disproportionate climate impacts despite contributing only 0.027 percent of global greenhouse gas emissions. Meanwhile, in France, Arcep reports that 95.3 percent of the country's 45.2 million premises are now connectable to fiber optics. While 65 percent of those eligible have adopted the technology, about 2.1 million premises remain unconnected. Operators note that for more than a third of these remaining locations, deployment was either refused by third parties, such as co-ownership syndicates, or the buildings are still under construction.

Liège Airport has lost about 27 percent of its Asian cargo following the introduction of a European Union three-euro charge on small parcels. Frederic Brun, the airport's VP of sales and marketing, notes that while the fee is significant, the way member states collect the levy is equally impactful. Belgium initially required substantial deposits from operators, but later shifted to a weekly prepayment system to help smaller companies survive. This contrasts with other countries that still require bank guarantees for periods ranging from one week to one month. Meanwhile, in Brazil, the Brazilian Association of Teleservices has asked Anatel to revise rules regarding anti-spam blocking tools. The association is concerned about how operators like Vivo and Claro identify and block inconvenient calls. They are now calling for a broader debate and a public consultation to refine the criteria used by these telecommunications services.

Russian strikes recently hit a Warsaw-bound train near the border between Ukraine and Poland. This attack occurred shortly after top Western figures had passed through the area. The European Union's top diplomat spoke on Monday regarding the timing of the strike. He stated that the operation was intended to scare off those backing Kyiv. While the diplomatic response focuses on this intent, the physical reality remains a direct hit on transit infrastructure near the Polish border. This incident adds a layer of tension to the region as Western allies continue their support for Ukraine.

R F Industries Ltd has filed its quarterly report with the SEC. The company, which specializes in electronic connectors and is incorporated in Nevada, submitted the Form 10-Q on September 14, 2026. This filing covers the reporting period ending July 31, 2026. Based in San Diego, California, the manufacturer provided a comprehensive submission including interactive data and several exhibits for certification. The documents were accepted by the SEC at 8:09 a.m. on the date of filing. This regulatory disclosure provides the latest financial snapshot for the firm as it maintains its operations under the electronic connectors industry classification.
After the headlines, back to the weather.
This afternoon will be partly cloudy with temperatures between 16 and 24 degrees.
And from the weather, a quick look at the calendar.
On your calendar today: Your personal calendar has Catan Jasper Iz at five in the evening, the BLISS Reading Group at six forty-five in the evening, and Twerchhau at seven in the evening.
Mail worth checking: Your Sparkasse has sent new messages and documents to your electronic mailbox.
And that's it for your personal morning broadcast.
[mature adult voice, intensely emotional, tender, radiant; hold a long breath after Rise] Rise... and shine.
[very very long pause before speaking; then mature adult voice, most emotional, strong, warm, radiant, deeply encouraging; hold a long breath after Rise] Rise... and shine.
